label: Multi-threat — V-shape FPV (5.8 GHz) + static 2.4 GHz jammer
description: Same 25-pod mesh + C&C, but with two concurrent emitters on different bands. Each pod listens on all three bands (3/4/5) via the multi-band sensor refactor — same hardware, separate solve windows per band. FPV drone flies a V-shape (NE down to soldier, then back up to NW) while a 2.4 GHz control jammer sits static at 6 km N. Tests interleaved-band alerts and the master's per-band lastAlertedByBand bookkeeping.
